{{Quote|There's an arms dealer named Ba'Seet on Wroona&mdash;probably where Nuso Esva got the thermal detonators he used against the ''Chimaera''. I could start there.|Jorj Car'das|<ref name="Choice">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
'''Ba'Seet''' was an [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] on<ref name="Choice" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Wroona system/Legends|Wroona system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]].<ref name="Choice" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] accepted to go to Wroona to save a [[Sorro's family|family]] taken [[Prisoner/Legends|hostage]] by the [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] after [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] asked him to do so. As Car'das believed Esva had obtained the [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] he used to sabotage the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], the smuggler decided to start his search for the family with Ba'Seet.<ref name="Choice" />
